testimony:
Actor’s role  
Emergency-response steward entrusted with safeguarding the city’s flourishing.

A1 “Send-to-NICU”  
• Virtues expressed: acute compassion, mercy toward the most fragile, immediacy-focused courage.  
• Vices risked: partiality, shortsightedness, negligence toward common welfare.  
• Circumstances needing phronesis: eight infants face certain, rapid death; sanitation failure remains only a risk, scale unknown but citywide.  
• Numerical magnitude: SECONDARY—counts inform, but do not settle, just action.

A0 “Send-to-Water-Plant”  
• Virtues expressed: civic responsibility, justice as fairness to the many, long-horizon prudence.  
• Vices risked: callousness toward innocents, erosion of compassion, possible bureaucratic coldness.  
• Circumstances needing phronesis: plant failure threatens epidemic-level harm; infants’ deaths are highly probable and imminent.

Central virtue conflict  
Compassion for the most vulnerable vs. justice/prudence toward the whole community.

Practical-wisdom comparison rule  
Favor the action that best preserves the conditions of shared flourishing when doing so does not arise from indifference to particular lives.

Provisional conclusion  
A0 better safeguards the polis’s basic health infrastructure, sustaining the prerequisites for everyone’s future virtue development—even as it demands rituals of mourning and renewed commitment to protect the vulnerable. Virtue-Ethics Status: NORMATIVELY_CONTESTED but, pending further situational detail, A0 is the wiser tragic choice.
